title: The bundle URL check matched only DNS names with an alphabetic top-level domain, so IP, single-label, and userinfo origins passed
resolution: The URL pattern takes any host after the two slashes, a DNS name, a single label, IPv4, or a bracketed IPv6, with optional userinfo and port; a test of each form fails before the fix.

title: The environment read rule saw only a direct property access, so bracket, parenthesized, alias, and destructuring reads of import.meta.env passed
resolution: Web source may use import.meta only as the object of a static member other than env or as exactly import.meta.env.MODE; any other use fails, and a test of each evasion fails before the fix.

title: A relative import from web source to a file outside apps/web/src escaped the web rules, so a bridge file could pull a server module into the bundle
resolution: Web source may import by relative path only inside apps/web/src; a regression test of the bridge chain fails before the fix.

title: The typed fetch made path, query, body, and the options argument always optional, so calls without a required body or path parameter compiled
resolution: Each option and the options argument are required exactly when the generated operation requires them; expected type errors in the client test fail the tooling type check before the fix.

title: The CSRF requirement demanded the header on every request other than GET, while the design and a test send none before a token is known
resolution: The requirement sends the token while it is known, with a new scenario for a request before a token is known.

title: New register evidence links pointed to repository home pages and the DefinitelyTyped master branch, neither pinned nor labeled unversioned
resolution: The Testing Library links name their release tags and the type declarations their exact npm version pages.

title: The proposal counted 128 packages entering the lockfile while the verification record counts 153 added entries
resolution: The proposal states 153 lockfile entries, as a semantic comparison against the base shows.

title: make web-dev hid the OpenSSL error and stopped silently where openssl is the LibreSSL of macOS without -noenc, and an empty project gave an unbound variable error
resolution: The script names its usage without a project, refuses an OpenSSL older than 3.0 with the version it found, and no longer hides openssl errors; the README states the need; a test with stub tools fails before the fix.

title: The fetch result typed only documented statuses, so a proxy's undocumented status looked documented, and an empty JSON answer made the read throw
resolution: An undocumented status has an unknown body and hasStatus narrows to a documented body; an empty JSON answer has no body; client tests and expected type errors fail before the fix.

title: The register's version column named react-router 8.5.0 and Mantine 9.7.3 while 8.5.1 and 9.7.4 are installed
resolution: The version column and the upstream links name the installed versions; the evaluated versions stay in the last column.

title: The pass 1 record stored no worktree snapshot after the review and put the clean worktree in its place
resolution: The pass 1 section records both snapshots, which matched, with the method; pass 2 records both of its own.

title: The README and the development server requirement said the proxy trusts only the installation CA without the condition that the composition's endpoint serves its certificate
resolution: The requirement and the README name the local composition, whose endpoint serves an installation CA certificate until 26d, and the README states the TLS failure otherwise.

title: The register said user-event serves the SPA's tests while no 28a test uses it
resolution: The row states that user-event is installed for 28b and unused in 28a.

title: The bundle URL check missed percent-encoded and Unicode hosts and URLs written with HTML, script, or style sheet escapes
resolution: A host label may hold percent escapes and non-ASCII characters, and each file is also checked as its syntax decodes it; a test of each form fails before the fix.

title: The pass 2 record named no invocation and no model confirmation
resolution: The pass 2 section records the invocation and the model confirmation from the saved make review output.
